welcome.mascotLabel: Hudhud the hoopoe, carrying a letter
welcome.title: A letter from you, five years from now.
welcome.body: Hudhud carries it. Most of it is smudged. Live your year, a week at a time, and the ink will settle.
welcome.promise: No right answers. No clock. Nothing is saved until your family says OK.

join.help: Join your class with the code from your teacher. We never ask for your name, phone number, email or photo.
join.title: Let's set you up
join.nicknameHint: 2 to 20 letters or numbers. Not your real name.
join.privacy: We never ask for your name, phone number, email or photo.
join.fixFields: Some answers need fixing. The first one is selected.
join.codeHelpBody: Your teacher writes it on the board or in the class WhatsApp group. Codes never use the letters O and I or the numbers 0 and 1.

errors.codeFormat: Codes have 6 letters and numbers, like RYB-4K2.
errors.codeLookalike: Codes never use O, 0, I or 1. Check that letter with your teacher, like RYB-4K2.
errors.codeNotAccepted: That code didn't work. Check each letter with your teacher.
errors.nicknameFormat: Use 2 to 20 letters or numbers, like Ayesha_10.
errors.nicknamePhone: Please don't add a phone number or email. Use a nickname instead.
errors.nicknameFullName: This looks like a full name. A nickname keeps you private, like Ayesha_10.
errors.birthRequired: Pick the month and the year you were born.
errors.schoolInactive: Your school's Rahyaab access isn't active right now. Please tell your teacher.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries for now. Please try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.offline: You're offline. Joining needs the internet once. Everything you typed is kept.
errors.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.nicknameTaken: Someone in your class already uses this nickname. Pick another, like one below.
errors.deviceBlocked: This phone can't join Rahyaab. Please talk to your teacher.

ageStop.title: Rahyaab is for students aged 13 and over
ageStop.body: Thank you for wanting to try it. Ask your teacher about other ways to explore careers.

home.title: Hello!
home.consentPendingBody: Until then, nothing you play is saved.
home.practiceNote: Just practice: nothing here counts towards your paths.
home.minutesLeft: Time left this week: about {{n}} min
home.allDone: You have played every week. Well done!
home.pathsLocked: Your paths open after {{weeks}} weeks of play, so they rest on enough of your choices.

library.title: Explore
library.help: Every study path, explained. Tap a path to see who it suits and where it can lead.
library.verify: Some details differ by board. Check them with your school.
library.costNote: An estimate: fees differ by school and city. Checked {{date}}.
library.source: Interest profile based on O*NET job data (U.S. Department of Labor).
library.notFound: This path is not in the library.

play.title: Play
play.help: Pick what you like: no answer is right or wrong, and there is no timer. Take a break any time; you will carry on from here.
play.problem: This part did not open. Go back home and try again.
play.prologueDone: Practice done! Your first real week is ready.

family.title: Family
family.body: You will share your Blueprint with your family from here.

settings.title: Accessibility
settings.readAloudHint: Show a speaker button next to lines, choices and explanations.
settings.autoReadHint: Read each new story line out loud by itself.
settings.autoReadTalkBack: Paused while TalkBack is on, so two voices don't talk at once. The speaker buttons still work.
settings.textSizeHint: Adds to your phone's text size, up to twice as big.
settings.readingFontHint: An easier-to-read font with more space between letters.
settings.highContrastHint: Stronger colours that are easier to see.
settings.reduceMotionHint: Fewer moving effects. On when your phone's own setting is on.

profile.title: Your details
profile.help: Your board and group decide which paths are open to you. You can change them any time.
profile.offline: You're offline. Your details load when you're back online.
profile.problem: Something went wrong. Please try again.
profile.boardHint: The board that sets your exams.
profile.matricGroupHint: The group you study in class 9 and 10.
profile.interGroupHint: What you study in class 11 and 12.
profile.noGroupYet: You choose your Matric group at the end of class 8. Rahyaab helps you with that.
profile.situationHint: Choose one if it is true for you.
profile.saved: Saved. Your next paths will use these details.
profile.notForYourClass: This group is not for your class. Please choose again.
profile.promptBody: Your group changes which paths are open to you.

situations.returning_learner: I left school and I am coming back
situations.changed_board: I moved to another board or province
situations.madrassa_or_foreign: I have a madrassa or foreign certificate

consent.help: Your family says OK on a paper form from school. Enter the code from that slip here, now or later.
consent.title: Your family's OK slip
consent.body: Your teacher gives your family a paper form. When they sign it and your teacher records it, you get a slip with a code.
consent.waiting: Until your family says OK, you can look around, but nothing you play is saved.
consent.helpBody: The code is printed on the slip your teacher gives back. Codes never use O, 0, I or 1. If it still doesn't work, ask your teacher.

errors.format: Slip codes have 8 letters and numbers, like AB23-CD45.
errors.lookalike: Slip codes never use O, 0, I or 1. Check that letter on the slip.
errors.notAccepted: That code didn't work. Check each letter on the slip, or ask your teacher.
errors.offline: You're offline. Please try again when you have internet.

results.provisional: A first look: the game is not finished yet, so these paths are a starting point, not an answer.

results.checkWithBoard: Check this with your school or board.

state.not_supported: Paths for your class come later.
state.offline: No internet. Your paths need a connection.
